statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-14831 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-02-09-2, GnuTLS issue #1773): verifying certificates with pathological amounts of name constraints could exhaust resources. GnuTLS fixed it in 3.8.12 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.14/NEWS), and Alpine lists it as fixed in gnutls 3.8.12-r0 (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD). The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository has published gnutls 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0, built from Alpine's aports at the same pkgver-pkgrel; the GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30, the library each published gnutls package holds, reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 respectively on both x86_64 and aarch64 (each package checked against its index checksum). 3.8.11-r0 is affected; 3.8.12-r0 is the first build that carries the fix, and 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 keep it.
